faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate position at BITS Pilani Goa Campus is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-graduate degree in Economics or International Relations with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the BITS Pilani Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST, Women) for the BITS Pilani Research Associate recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post at the Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani K K Birla Goa Campus.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary shortlisting based on the resume, followed by a telephonic/audio-visual interview, and finally a personal interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is a contractual job at BITS Pilani Goa Campus.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Goa apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any geographical restrictions for applicants. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria from any location can apply.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article by clicking on the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of BITS Pilani Goa Campus?
faq.answer: The official website of BITS Pilani Goa Campus is https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/goa/. You can visit this site for more information about the institute and its activities.
